style: flat vector cartoon, thick dark outline, chunky casual mobile game art, bold flat colours, high contrast, clean silhouette
notes: One art style for the whole project, repeated word for word at the head of every prompt (rule F.1c). Every mechanical sprite declares its orientation in words (rule C.8); the symmetric ones say so explicitly so nothing is mirrored by accident - only sprite_verge_sign is asymmetric, and the code mirrors it deliberately for the left verge. Sprites are drawn on whatever backdrop the model likes, because the pipeline cuts the background away (rule F.1b), so no prompt argues about background colour. sprite_slot_frame, sprite_plate_panel and sprite_road_tile carry a nine-slice border in their .meta, so their prompts ask for a uniform rim and a flat centre that survives stretching. sprite_road_tile is stacked vertically, so its prompt describes its top and bottom EDGES rather than its geometry (rule F.1d). The four parcel colours each carry a different white stamp shape, so the order strip stays readable on a compressed screenshot and for a colourblind player. No prompt contains the app name, and no sprite carries lettering of any kind (hard rule 1).
